items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 as fracture damage to a fitting inside the building caused by frost; indemnity includes the fitting, necessary connection elements, labour, and one attendance. Reference Case 16 shows t between 48 and 55 for this exact item.
Covered as a necessary connection element renewed with the fractured fitting under 7.1.9. Reference Case 16 shows t between 27 and 33 for this item.
Labour for covered repair is indemnified under 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9. Reference Case 16 shows t >= 274 for 3 hours; use 280 as a moderate estimate.
Excluded under 3.6(c) and 7.1.7(e) unless actually consumed in covered work; reference Case 16 shows t below 11, possibly 0 (lowest charge proven too high).
Vehicle costs for a covered attendance are indemnified under 7.1.11. Reference Case 16 shows t >= 60 for this line.
Leak location is covered under 2.4.6 and 5.2.2, but reference Case 16 shows t below 57, possibly 0 (lowest charge proven too high).

items.description: Facade frost damage from outdoor freeze-thaw
items.rationale: Not covered: 2.6.1/2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude frost damage to external surfaces unless the optional peril is agreed, which is not stated in the description or schedule.
Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes removal and renewal of failed surface material from external surfaces where the frost peril is not agreed.
Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes renewal of substrate and base plaster for external surfaces where the frost peril is not agreed.

items.description: Premium insulated render system (upgrade on former plain plaster)
items.rationale: Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes all work on external surfaces for frost damage where the peril is not agreed; 7.1.10 also excludes upgrades beyond pre-loss standard.
Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes renewal of substrate and new plaster for external surfaces where the frost peril is not agreed.
Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes all finish coats for external surfaces where the frost peril is not agreed.
Not covered: 7.1.5 and 3.5(b) exclude work on undamaged areas and all work on external surfaces for frost damage where the peril is not agreed.
Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes priming and all preparatory work for external surfaces where the frost peril is not agreed.
Not covered: 3.5(b) excludes all labour for external surface frost repairs where the peril is not agreed. Reference Case 16 shows t below 17, possibly 0.
Not covered: 3.5(b) and 7.1.12 exclude lump-sum items for external surface frost repairs where the peril is not agreed.
